race.comment: BACK TO BONDI (1) made it back-to-back wins last start at this track and trip and the form out of that race has held up well. Drawn wider this time, but he has the speed to work across and sit handy. He's a track and trip winner though and he can continue his winning ways. STREAMLINED (7) won impressively fresh before a 0.9L defeat last start at Belmont, with the rise out to 1600m looking right up his alley. Will need some luck from the wide alley, but should be helped by a couple of gear changes and he can show what he's capable of. VEXATIOUS ROSE (10) flew home last start behind BACK TO BONDI in a strong effort and she draws a better barrier this time around. She drops in weight as well and if she can run up to her best, she'll be hard to hold out. STATEWIDE (5) won't be far away if he runs up to recent efforts. PURE MAC (3) will give them something to chase from the front and meets BACK TO BONDI better at the weights this time.
